summaries.text: Senior Backend Engineer with 8+ years of experience in logistics and payments platforms. Cut nightly report runtime from 6 hours to 40 minutes at Harbor Logistics and launched a refunds service at Brightwave Payments. Led 3 engineers through a zero-downtime JDK 17 upgrade, raised unit coverage on a checkout API and migrated stored card tokens to a new vault.
